classification_rationale: The customer disputes a damage charge as ordinary wear and asks for it to be waived, which is a waiver request the damage-assessment policy already resolves.

draft.reply_body:
Hi Teemu,

Thanks for raising this, and we understand it's frustrating. That said, damage charges are assessed against our repair-cost schedule and, once they've been worked out and sent to you, our policy is that they're final - we're not able to waive or renegotiate them after the event, even for a long-standing customer. So the 260 EUR charge on booking RB-20262082 stands.

If you think the damage was there before you picked the compactor up, let us know and we can check that against our check-out photos and inspection record - that's the one situation where a charge like this would be reversed.

We're still checking the Kempele schedule for your date change on this booking too and will come back to you with available dates shortly.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy
